newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Yacyreta construction tender in 1998 - official.
newsitem.headline: Yacyreta construction tender in 1998 - official.

text.p: Argentina and Paraguay will call a tender in 1998 for the completion of works on their jointly-owned Yacyreta hydroelectric dam, a Paraguayan official said Tuesday.
The winners of the tender will be paid via a surcharge on the dam's electricity sales, Deputy Mines and Energy Minister Jorge Lamar told reporters.

The Paraguayan and Argentine governments had originally planned to grant a 30-year concession to operate the giant dam, which has cost $10 billion so far, but neither could gain authorization from their congresses.
The two countries now plan to complete the remaining two-percent of the dam construction before any privatization.
The dam on the Parana River on the border between Argentina and Paraguay has a 39-mile (62 km) wall.
